response.original_title: THE THREE STIGMATA OF PHILIP K. DICK
response.overview: A documentary exploring the ideas of Philip K. Dick, whose work continually questioned the nature of reality, identity and the boundaries between the authentic and the counterfeit. Through Dick’s own voice, archival interviews, television appearances and speeches, the film journeys through his visions of alternate realities, paranoia and revelation.
response.tagline: “Reality, to me, is not so much something that you perceive, but something you make.” - Philip K. Dick
response.title: THE THREE STIGMATA OF PHILIP K. DICK
